options: Nothing meaningful; it is a purely cosmetic step
A purchase order being communicated to the wrong supplier
A requisition being submitted without approval
Paying a supplier based solely on their own claim, without independently verifying price, quantity, or actual delivery
questions.explain: Matching is the control that checks a supplier's invoice against independent evidence (the PO and often the receipt) before payment is allowed.

questions.q: What does 3-way matching check that 2-way matching does not?
options: That the quantity billed does not exceed the quantity actually received, using the receipt as a check
The supplier's tax ID number
The requester's job title
The currency exchange rate
questions.explain: 3-way matching adds the receipt as a check, confirming quantity billed does not exceed quantity received - 2-way matching only checks against the PO.

questions.q: Why is LTV's bearing purchase order set to require 3-way matching rather than 2-way?
options: Because 3-way matching is required for every purchase order regardless of item type
Because physical delivery confirmation matters for a mechanical part, making it important to verify goods were actually received before paying
Because Meridian Bearing Supply Co. refuses to accept 2-way matching
Because the purchase order amount exceeds a certain dollar threshold
questions.explain: The match approval level was set considering that physical delivery confirmation is important for this kind of item, making 3-way matching the appropriate control.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a matching tolerance?
options: To prevent any invoice from ever being paid
To automatically increase the purchase order's price
To allow a small, configured amount of price or quantity variance to pass without being treated as a problem
To replace the need for a receipt entirely
questions.explain: Tolerances define acceptable variance so that minor, normal differences (rounding, shipping variance) do not unnecessarily block payment.

questions.q: What happens if Meridian's invoice had billed for 55 units when only 50 were ordered and received, outside tolerance?
options: The invoice would be paid immediately regardless
Payables would place a matching hold on the invoice, blocking payment until the discrepancy is resolved
The purchase order would automatically increase to 55 units
Receipt Accounting would reverse the original receipt automatically
questions.explain: An invoice that falls outside configured tolerances triggers a matching hold, which must be resolved before the invoice can be paid.
